nodes.label: architect Agent
nodes.rationale: Plans and documents only (opus, high effort); produces TDD-ordered plan with PR breakdown in docs/plans/ grounded in real repo paths.

nodes.label: code-reviewer Agent
nodes.rationale: Reviews and reports only (sonnet, high); checks correctness, TDD quality, architecture/abstraction bar, security, docs, sizing, domain invariants; single compact report with verdict.

nodes.label: senior-full-stack-dev Agent
nodes.rationale: Implements approved plans faithfully under strict TDD (sonnet, high); escalates rather than redesigns; does not commit/push unless asked.

nodes.label: /dev Command (implement then auto-review)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator delegates implementation to senior-full-stack-dev then automatically to code-reviewer; does not implement or review itself.

nodes.label: The Abstraction Bar (YAGNI, simplicity)
nodes.rationale: Interfaces only at genuinely swapped boundaries; no single-implementation wrappers/factories; no premature optimisation; concrete code is easier to follow.

nodes.label: Abstraction First at Service Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Swapping a provider should only require a new implementation class, never a change to core logic.

nodes.label: Commit and PR Sizing Hard Rule
nodes.norm_label: commit and pr sizing hard rule
nodes.rationale: Small atomic commits and single-purpose PRs make review careful, history bisectable and revertable; larger features use main <- feat/<feature> <- feat/<feature>/<slice> branching.

nodes.label: Configuration by Variability (env vs DB)
nodes.rationale: Static/secret values go to env typed settings; runtime/per-user values go to DB with audit trail.

nodes.label: Domain Safety Invariants
nodes.rationale: Money as integer paise; audit trail on every create/edit/delete; SMS/email read-only; deterministic on-device parsing; auto-logged transactions never silently dropped/merged/altered; hardcoded and not disableable.

nodes.label: Model Policy for Role Agents
nodes.rationale: Builds run on owner's Claude Pro plan so cost matters: Opus plans, Sonnet builds, Sonnet reviews; escape hatch to Opus for hard steps; user's explicit model choice wins.

nodes.label: Observability Without Leaking
nodes.rationale: Structured local logs and a local diagnostics screen; logs never contain amounts, payees, message text, account ids or tokens.

nodes.label: Rule A: Mandatory TDD (Red-Green-Refactor)
nodes.rationale: No production code before a failing test; unit and integration tests required; >=90% coverage on core is a floor but meaningless tests are a failure.

nodes.label: Rule B: Mandatory Documentation
nodes.rationale: Every behaviour change updates inline docs, module README, feature doc, architecture, code-structure, learnings and project README in the same unit of work.

nodes.label: Rule C: Security Built In
nodes.rationale: Fail closed; no secrets in code/logs; protected paths; untrusted input validated; parameterised queries; minimal Android surface (gmail.readonly, drive.appdata, allowBackup off, FLAG_SECURE); pinned and scanned deps.

nodes.label: Learning: toolchain pinned old; build tool is not the IDE
nodes.norm_label: learning: toolchain pinned old; build tool is not the ide
nodes.rationale: Newer Studio opens older AGP projects; Gradle JVM criteria keep Studio and gradlew on same JDK.

nodes.label: core/shared Shared Packages
nodes.rationale: Shared code promoted on the second consumer, never copied.

nodes.label: Layered Modular Architecture (core vs app)
nodes.rationale: core/<module> is pure Kotlin with no Android imports and owns business logic and repository interfaces; app/ is a thin Android layer; app depends on core, never reverse.
